list.name: Changes
list.comment: Implemented getTotal() method to calculate the complete order price from sandwiches, drinks, and chips. Added order validation to ensure customers cannot place empty orders. Supported flexible ordering by allowing orders with sandwiches, drinks, or chips combinations.

task.summary: Created initial class structure for DELI-cious,Added package including ui,models and Util.I added foundational model classes including Drink,Sandwich, Chips,Topping,Userinterface,Order and ReceiptWriter.
I created Sandwich class with bread type, size, and toasted properties
Add Topping class with topping types and extra topping support
Add Drink class with size and flavor properties Create Size enum with SMALL, MEDIUM, and LARGE options Implement constructor for drink initialization
Add Chips class for order side items Implement chip type property and fixed pricing Create constructor and price getter method
Add Chips class for order side items Implement chip type property and fixed pricing Create constructor and price getter method

Add comprehensive Topping model with pricing logic Implemented ToppingType enum to support MEAT, CHEESE, REGULAR, SAUCE, and SIDE categories.Added constructors for standard and extra toppings, including support for marking toppings as extra.Created dynamic pricing logic based on sandwich size and topping type using switch expressions. Implemented separate pricing rules for regular and extra meat/cheese toppings.Added getter and setter methods for topping properties to support encapsulation.Overrode toString() method to display toppings clearly, including extra topping labels.

Enhance Chips model with order summary support Added fixed-price Chips class to represent side items in customer orders. Implemented getSummary() method to generate formatted receipt-style output for chips.Added getter method for chip type to improve data access and encapsulation.Maintained constant pricing structure using static final PRICE variable.

Create Drink class with pricing and summary functionality Added Size enum to support SMALL, MEDIUM, and LARGE drink options. Implemented dynamic pricing logic based on selected drink size. Added formatted summary output for receipts and order details. Included getter methods for drink size and flavor properties.

Build customizable Sandwich model with toppings and pricing system Implemented sandwich customization with bread type, size, toasted option, and categorized toppings. Added support for meats, cheeses, regular toppings, sauces, and sides using ArrayLists. Created dynamic pricing logic based on sandwich size and premium toppings.Implemented formatted order summary generation for receipts and customer orders. Added validation for sandwich sizes and getter methods for encapsulation.

Create Order class to manage customer purchases Added ArrayLists to store sandwiches, drinks, and chips within an order. Implemented Order constructor to initialize all order item collections. Prepared foundation for handling customer order totals and receipt generation.

Implemented getTotal() method to calculate the complete order price from sandwiches, drinks, and chips. Added order validation to ensure customers cannot place empty orders. Supported flexible ordering by allowing orders with sandwiches, drinks, or chips combinations.
